title: Bite (Sabre-Toothed Tiger)
html:
This article is about the variant of Bite available in Sabre-Toothed Tiger wild shape form. For other uses, see Bite (disambiguation).
Bite is the basic attack available in  Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger form. It has a chance to knock targets  Prone which makes them susceptible to  Jugular Strike.

Description

Bite a target.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Damage: 2~12 + modifiers
2d6 + Strength modifier⁠Piercing
Details
 Melee Unarmed Attack Roll
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)

At higher levels

  • At level 4, this attack deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Piercing damage.
  • At level 8, this additional damage becomes 1d8⁠⁠Piercing.
  • At level 12, this additional damage becomes 1d10⁠⁠Piercing.

Technical details

UID
Target_Bite_SaberTooth
Spell flags
IsAttack, IsHarmful, IsMelee

Condition: Prone

 Prone

Duration: 2 turns

 STR Save (DC 14)

  • Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
  • A Prone creature must spend half its  Movement Speed to stand up.
  • Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration.
  • If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends.

How to learn

Used by creatures: Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger

Notes

  • Unlike most Wild Shape actions, this attack has a fixed DC of 14 which does not scale with the druid's spellcasting modifier.
